name: envi platform (workspace)
install: S="$(find /agent /home /root /workspace -maxdepth 6 -name install.sh -path '*/.cursor/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; echo "using install: $S"; bash "$S"
start: S="$(find /agent /home /root /workspace -maxdepth 6 -name start.sh -path '*/.cursor/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; echo "using start: $S"; bash "$S"

terminals.name: wms (react-router :5173)
terminals.command: source ~/.envi-workspace-env 2>/dev/null; cd "${ENVI_REPOS_ROOT:-/agent/repos}/envi-wms" && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && npm run dev -- --port 5173
